title: SCS001-A — Batch Faceless Reels: Hook Formula Table Generator
description: SCS001-A addendum implementation. Build the batch content generation pipeline that produces 100-row hook formula tables for Canva Bulk Create. Uses SCS001 Part 3's 9 hook formulas. Output: structured CSV/JSON table ready for Canva import. Source: SCS001-A Batch Production Pipeline.

tasks.title: Create batch hook formula table generator script
tasks.context:
Create scripts/scs001/batch-hook-generator.ts — generates a 100-row content table for Canva Bulk Create.

The script should:
1. Accept a --count parameter (default 100) and --output parameter (default workspace/scs001/batch-output.csv)
2. Use ClawRouter to call a local LLM (qwen3:14b via Ollama at localhost:11434) with the SCS001-A batch generation prompt
3. The prompt template (embedded in the script):
   - Generate {count} rows with columns: TOPIC, HOOK_LINE, PAYOFF_LINE
   - Rotate evenly across 9 hook formulas: Curiosity Gap, Contrarian, Specific Number, Relatable Pain, Reveal Tease, Direct Address, Bold Claim, Story Start, Challenge
   - Content verticals: AI agents, building with AI, sovereign technology, agent economics, digital identity, creator tools, future of work
   - Grade 7 reading level, conversational
4. Parse the LLM output into a structured array of {topic, hook_line, payoff_line, hook_formula}
5. Write output as CSV with headers: Topic,Hook Line,Payoff Line,Hook Formula
6. Also write JSON version to workspace/scs001/batch-output.json for analytics

Handle LLM output parsing robustly — the model may output markdown tables, pipe-delimited, or numbered lists. Parse all common formats.

Do NOT use any external npm packages. Use Node built-ins only (fs, path, http/https for Ollama API).
